policies.title: Myanmar ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule places Myanmar in its prior-to-arrival cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Myanmar passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained from a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
Work, residence, study, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Myanmar ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule places Myanmar in its authorized-visa cohort for advance consular approval.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Myanmar passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
The cited Embassy says authorized-visa approval may take up to 60 business days and requires an in-person consular application.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: The current PP 10998 full suspension, which calls Myanmar Burma, preserves valid-visa grandfathering, specified exceptions and case-by-case waivers; it cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
The PP 10998 rule applies to entry and visa issuance into the United States; the INA geographical definition includes Puerto Rico. Its exceptions cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
The PP 10998 rule applies to entry and visa issuance into the United States; the INA geographical definition includes Guam. Its exceptions cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.

The PP 10998 rule applies to entry and visa issuance into the United States; the INA geographical definition includes the Northern Mariana Islands. Its exceptions cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.

The PP 10998 rule applies to entry and visa issuance into the United States; the INA geographical definition includes the U.S. Virgin Islands. Its exceptions cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
